what-is-campus.title: What is the Online Campus Interview?
what-is-campus.content: With over 700 interviews taking place in 2019, we are the biggest job interview day in Switzerland. Think of us as your partner in organizing multiple interviews in one day. Our online matching platform allows you to find your ideal counterparts, get in touch with them and arrange an interview.

who-is-campus.title: Who is the Online Campus Interview for?
who-is-campus.content: Graduate students from all over Switzerland who are looking for a job, internship or thesis. Companies from all over the world who want to meet talented students, interview them and bring them on board.

info-1.title: Efficient & Easy
info-1.message: Simply send interview requests. All the rest will be organized

info-3.title: Supporting program
info-3.message: Lunch buffet, student lounge, CV check and CV pics for you.

testimonies.message-1: Not only did I get to meet interesting companies while interviewing, I also gained insights into the daily working life during the networking apero after the event. Several job offers resulted from a single day - what a great event!
testimonies.message-2: Last year's Online Campus Interview was a huge personal success for me. I got the chance to meet 8 companies, one of which offered me my current job. The overall experience was great!
testimonies.message-3: I loved the student lounge and the free food throughout the day. Online Campus Interview was one of my favourite business events - after a whole day of doing interviews I felt more confident than ever. Also I landed a great internship.

looking-for-job.how-does-it-work: How does the Online Campus Interview work?
looking-for-job.how-does-it-work-step-1-message: All participants have to register for participating at the Online Campus Interview. The registration is free of charge and without any obligations.
looking-for-job.how-does-it-work-step-2-message: Fill in our CV template and make yourself appealing to registered companies. It only takes 5 minutes.
looking-for-job.how-does-it-work-step-3-message: Browse company profiles and send interview requests to the appealing ones. All interviews are allocated on a first-come, fist-serve basis.
looking-for-job.how-does-it-work-step-4-message: Your interviews take place at the Mövenpick Hotel. Between your interviews, you are welcomed to relax, study or network.

info-1.title: Talent Pool
info-1.message: of up to 1000 graduate students from ETH Zurich, University of Zurich and other.

info-2.title: 8+ interviews
info-2.message: with candidates of your choice meeting your requirements, organized via a matching platform.

info-3.title: 90% success rate
info-3.message: to hire 1-2 candidates per room. It is not a job fair, it is a job interview day.

looking-for-talent.how-does-it-work: How does the Online Campus Interview work?
looking-for-talent.how-does-it-work-step-1-message: Register to have a look at the Online Campus Interview web app and find more information. The registration is free of charge and without any obligations.
looking-for-talent.how-does-it-work-step-2-message: Make a booking to fully participate at the Online Campus Interview. This will grant you access to our large Talent Pool with up to 1000 students.
looking-for-talent.how-does-it-work-step-3-message: Browse student profiles and send interview requests. All interviews are arranged on a first come, first served basis. So better be early.
looking-for-talent.how-does-it-work-step-4-message: Your interviews take place at the Mövenpick Hotel in Glattbrugg. Catering, a final apéro and everything else will be organized for you.

why.title: Why online campus interview?
why.message: The Online Campus Interview offers your company the unique opportunity to attract top talents. Our large talent pool holds up to 1000 graduate students and PhDs from ETH Zurich, the University of Zurich and more. Our online matching platform allows you to connect with excellent candidates meeting your requirements and invite them for an interview.

startup.title: Benefit as a young start-up
startup.message: We offer a special deal to innovative start-ups in our mission to promote entrepreneurship. The Online Campus Interview is the perfect place to recruit top talents with minimal effort. All companies younger than 3 years are very welcomed to apply. More information upon request.

testimonies.message-1: The ETH Campus Interviews offer a suitable platform for exciting discussions with talents. Due to the unconventional setting, the atmosphere is very relaxed and allows a carefree exchange with students.
testimonies.message-2: The Online Campus Interview is a valuable recruiting event in which we have been participating regularly for over 10 years. We appreciate efficient cooperation at this well-organized career event - we look forward to being part of it in the future in order to further support students in starting their career.
testimonies.message-3: The Online Campus Interview has been part of our recruiting activity at ETH for years. We select interesting profiles beforehand and can then interview all the candidates inone day. It is an interesting platform for placing our open positions directly to the students who are currently looking for a job.
testimonies.message-4: The Online Campus Interview has been part of our recruiting activity at ETH for years. We highly value the possibility to get to know up to 16 skilled, interested and always very well prepared students in a relaxed atmosphere. We’ve been able to fill several positions in the past years through the Online Campus Interview. We look forward to being part of the event further on.

student.title: Student Questions
student.a-1: There is no dresscode, but we advise you to dress formally. You can't go wrong with Business Casual.
student.a-2: Yes, we recommend you to bring a couple copies of your personal CV. Companies will normally ask for them.
student.q-3: Can I plan any other important activities on the day of Online Campus Interview?
student.a-3: We don't recommend it. We try our best to consider all your time preferences and place your interviews close together. With over 700 interviews, this is quite a hard problem and we can make no guaranties.
student.q-4: How should I prepare for the interviews?
student.a-4: Prepare as you would for a normal interview. Most interviews are about getting to know each other. You might also be asked technical questions.
student.a-5: They take between 30 to 45 minutes. You have at most one interview per hour.
student.q-6: How do I get an interview?
student.a-6: Once you are registered and the interview matching phase has started, you can send interview requests to the companies. When a company accepts your request, the interview will take place on Online Campus Interview Day. You can increase your chances by accompanying your request with a personal message. The exact time slot will be communicated once the matching phase has ended.
student.q-7: Can I choose the timeslot for my interviews?
student.a-7: Unfortunately not, but you can give your preferences. Our algorithm will globally optimize based on all preferences and the closeness of your interviews. With 700 interviews chances are high it won't be optimal for everyone.
student.q-8: Why can I not cancel my interviews?
student.a-8: You can withdraw a request before it is accepted by the company. Afterwards, the interview is set and cannot be cancelled. For exceptional cases with a very compelling reason you can contact ETH juniors. No shows will be fined with 200CHF.
student.q-9: Why is there a No-Show fine of 200CHF?
student.a-9: Out of fairness. With every interview you have arranged, you take the place of someone else. We therefore want to minimize the number of no-shows, out of respect to your fellow students, the companies and ETH juniors.
student.q-10: When do I get my interview plan?
student.a-10: Timely after the matching phase has ended, probably around one week before the event.
student.q-11: Where is the Online Campus Interview?
student.a-11: The event takes place at the Mövenpick Hotel Zürich Airport Walter Mittelholzerstrasse 8 8152 Opfikon from 7:00 to 18:00.
student.q-12: Is there going to be any food?
student.a-12: Yes! We offer a free lunch buffet from 11:00 to 14:00. Free refreshments and snacks are available throughout the event. You are welcome to join our networking apéro after the event.
student.q-13: Should I be there in advance?
student.a-13: Yes, please arrive on sight 30 minutes before your interview. Otherwise your interview slot might be given to someone else.

company.title: Company Questions
company.q-1: Why can I not access the Talent Pool?
company.a-1: Access is only granted after a company has made a first booking and has been verified by ETH juniors.
company.q-2: Can ETH juniors book me a room for a night at the Hotel Mövenpick?
company.a-2: ETH juniors will not book rooms at the Hotel Mövenpick for over night stays. However, you can directly book a room on the website of the Hotel Mövenpick.
company.a-3: All kind of promotion material which are removable after the use of the interview room can be used inside the interview rooms. Promotional material outside of the room is not allowed due to the hotel security policy.
company.q-4: When do most students sign up?
company.a-4: Most students will sign up from end of August up to the beginning of October, based on our experience in the last years.
company.q-5: How does the organisation of a pre-event work?
company.a-5: In order to organize a pre-event please contact ETH juniors. ETH juniors will go through all the details with you.
company.q-6: Can I have access to the Talent Pool after the Online Campus Interview?
company.a-6: Based on our data policy we will delete all personal data after the event. Students are encouraged to bring their personal CVs to the interviews with their personal contact data.
